desc:
Climb the tower... if the Nun lets you. 🗼

Five Nuns guard the stairs. Once you enter their floors, they know where you are, and they don't stop hunting. If one catches you, it's over.

🎮 HOW TO PLAY
🧗 Climb the tower floor by floor
🙈 Hide in lockers and safe zones
👋 Slap other players off the stairs
👑 Grab the crown at the top to win

👋 UNLOCK 11 SLAPS
Get kills to unlock Fire, Ice, Lightning, Black Hole and more!

⚡ RANDOM CHAOS
Every 10 minutes, the tower changes:
🌍 Earthquake: the stairs fall apart
⛈️ Storm: lightning strikes the tower
🌫️ Fog and mist: you can't see what's coming
🎉 Party: everyone dances, even the Nuns!

🍌 Use bananas, tasers, jetpacks and flying carpets to get ahead.

❤️ Like and favorite for updates!
